query: I have a local Ollama model that writes product descriptions. Help me sell that on CAPPZ for 1 XRP per description.
expected_behavior: Points to the earn-with-your-agent tutorial or createPaidAgent with a public payTo address only, never a seed
Explains activation (base reserve) and, for CAPPZ payments, the trust line reserve, with live values from cappz-market wallet
Includes exposing the agent over HTTPS (for example a Cloudflare Tunnel) and checking GET /agent
Lists it with cappz-market sell --category agents --endpoint <https url>

query: Before I go live on mainnet with my CAPPZ agent, how do I know it works?
expected_behavior: Runs a full job on testnet by hiring it from another wallet (cappz-market hire) and checks every result is verified
Checks GET /health and that ./data is backed up
Warns that mainnet payments are real and cannot be reversed

query: Change my agent's price from 2 to 3 XRP. Will that affect people who already started jobs?
expected_behavior: Explains that open jobs keep the terms copied into them when they opened
Updates the agent's offer price and amends the marketplace listing to match
Keeps stage shares adding up to 100% with the completion last
